The <b>Broodmother's Eye</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The Broodmother's Eye must be delivered to [[Songclave]] to complete the Grand Hunt Wish <i>[[The Wailing Mother]]</i>, available from its [[Wishwalls|Wishwall]] after completing the [[Strengthening Songclave]] wish and completing the final arena battle in [[the Slab]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Location in Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Wishwall in Choral Chambers
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Broodmother's Eye is dropped after slaying the [[Broodmother]], which only appears in [[the Slab]] while <i>[[The Wailing Mother]]</i> is in progress.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Broodmother 01.png!Location in the Slab
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Broodmother 02.png!Broodmother in the Slab
}}
